metadata.title: Psychedelic Pop Circular Frame Album Art

retrievalProfile.description: A central group portrait enclosed within a concentric multi-colored rainbow ring, featuring arched display typography following the outer curve.
triggerTerms: retro band portrait in a circle

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central photographic subject framed by a thick, multi-colored concentric ring. The ring consists of primary and secondary colors (red, blue, orange, yellow). Bold, stylized typography arches along the top and bottom edges of the circle, creating a balanced, symmetrical layout typical of late 1960s pop culture.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric rainbow rings framing a central photographic subject
Arched typography mirroring the curvature of the circular frame
High-contrast white background emphasizing the saturated color rings
Symmetrical balance between top and bottom text arcs
coreInvariants: The circular rainbow frame must consist of at least four distinct color bands.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central photographic group, scaled to fit within the inner diameter of the circular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The multi-colored concentric ring serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top arched text, following the ring down to the bottom text, and settling on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the corners outside the circle and within the circle behind the subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red, blue, orange, and yellow for the concentric rings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic rings contrasted against a neutral, brightly lit photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Primary and secondary colors only for the rings

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif and stylized display faces
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a heavy, slightly flared sans-serif with tight kerning.
Bottom text uses a condensed, high-contrast sans-serif.
All text is warped along a circular path.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals on the top display face are slightly angled to follow the radial axis.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face for the title paired with a condensed functional face for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and slight flare of the top display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and density for the bottom arc.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a white background. In the center, place a group of people in 1960s attire. Surround them with a thick frame made of four concentric rings in red, blue, orange, and yellow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply black uppercase text along the top outer edge of the circle using a heavy flared sans-serif. Apply smaller black uppercase text along the bottom outer edge using a condensed sans-serif, separating items with bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly aligned to the circular path?
Are the four color rings distinct and saturated?
Is the central portrait contained within the inner ring?

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility along the curve.
Ensure the color rings are concentric and not eccentric.
Verify the white balance of the central image matches the background.
Confirm the decorative asterisk is centered between top words.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Concentric primary-color rings + Arched bold sans-serif typography = 1960s Pop Aesthetic.
